tickets.title: Production Deadlock: Synchronous Kafka RPC consumer lag blocking checkout authorizations
tickets.summary: Synchronous request-response pattern implemented on Kafka topics deadlocked when consumer rebalances stalled payment authorization reply partitions. Direct catalyst for ADR-051 and deprecation of synchronous Kafka RPC.

tickets.summary: Catastrophic 4-hop cascading failure: redis-session-store memory eviction triggered 504 Gateway Timeouts in auth-token-validator, causing checkout-orchestrator backpressure, and halting stripe-webhook-worker.

tickets.title: ML Inference Worker CUDA Memory Leak & OOM Killer crash under batch tensor load
tickets.summary: PyTorch worker nodes encountering CUDA memory fragmentation and uncollected tensor graphs after 72h runtime. Mitigation documented in DOC-012.

tickets.title: ML Inference Worker CUDA Memory Leak Resurfaces: Worker nodes OOM killed on GPU shard 4
tickets.summary: Exact recurrence of INC-045: PyTorch worker nodes experiencing CUDA memory leak and OOM crash under batched tensor inference. Requires DOC-012 procedure.

tickets.title: Recommendation Engine Unmarshaling Panic: Missing required field 'account_tier' in User Profile payload

messages.text: Team, INC-204 was unacceptable. We had checkout authorization hanging for 45 minutes because Kafka consumer partition rebalance paused replies.
Agreed Marcus. ADR-018 originally prescribed Kafka for RPC back in 2023, but at our current 85,000 req/sec scale, async RPC emulation over message queues creates unbounded tail latencies.
From SRE vantage: when broker rebalance triggers, timeouts cascade to upstream proxies. We must move synchronous inter-service calls directly to gRPC with HTTP/2 and mTLS.
Identity team supports this. We have protobuf specs ready. I will draft ADR-051 to officially deprecate sync Kafka RPC and supersede ADR-018 immediately.
Consensus reached. Let's record ADR-051 and update all service runbooks. Note: Ensure onboarding docs get updated so newcomers stop using Kafka for sync queries!

# Service Communication Standards (Deprecated)

All microservices within 7bit Cloud Technologies MUST use Kafka for synchronous request-response communication. Publish requests to `<service>.requests` topic and subscribe to correlation UUIDs on `<service>.replies`.

WARNING: This document is OUTDATED and CONTRADICTS ADR-051! Do not use Kafka for synchronous RPC; use gRPC over HTTP/2.

documents.title: Runbook: ML Inference Worker PyTorch CUDA Memory Leak Mitigation & Shard Recycling
documents.content:
# ML Inference Worker CUDA OOM Triage Runbook

## Symptoms:
- PyTorch worker nodes experiencing CUDA memory fragmentation and uncollected tensor graphs after 72h runtime.
- Linux kernel OOM Killer terminating process `torch_worker` with ExitCode 137 on GPU shard 4.

## Resolution Steps:
1. Trigger rolling pod restart with command: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/ml-inference-worker -n ml-prod`.
2. Force CUDA cache deallocation via admin probe: `curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/admin/cuda/empty_cache`.
3. Verify tensor shard memory stabilizes under 14GB on Grafana dashboard #402.
4. Check historical incident reference: INC-045 and active recurrence INC-249.
